profile.name: Khalfan Athman
profile.bio: Disciplined Network Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with 6+ years of IT infrastructure and production web development experience. Specializing in Python (Django REST Framework), high-performance Next.js 15 frontends, enterprise TCP/IP networking, and secure cloud architectures. Proven track record of delivering resilient, high-traffic national platforms and administrative systems.

experience.title: Assistant IT Manager (Network Engineer)
achievements: Proactively architected and developed the complete jamiaGive donation and financial auditing platform (Next.js, TypeScript, DRF, PostgreSQL) featuring real-time donor tracking, multi-category fund allocation, and audit trails.
Configured and maintained Panasonic KX-NS500 hybrid IP-PBX telephony infrastructure, managing IP desk phones, digital extensions, SIP trunks, and automated IVR call routing.
Installed and administered Hikvision biometric access control systems, facial recognition terminals, and integrated computerized time & attendance management software.
Served as technical liaison with third-party enterprise vendors to implement, troubleshoot, and maintain Tally ERP accounting systems.
Configured TP-Link managed switches with 802.1Q VLAN traffic segmentation, inter-VLAN routing, and port security policies, boosting network resilience.
Engineered campus-wide Wi-Fi coverage with Ubiquiti UniFi wireless access point (AP) installations, central UniFi controller provisioning, and isolated guest/staff SSIDs.
Managed Jamia Mosque high-capacity public address (PA) and acoustic sound systems, controlling mixer channels, feedback suppression, and multi-zone distribution.

experience.title: Lead Full-Stack Solutions Engineer
achievements: Architected and launched the SUPKEM Digital Portal (supkem.org), providing bilingual news CMS, executive directory, and nationwide event registration.
Built and deployed the Langata Islamic Center web platform (langataislamiccenter.org) with Next.js and DRF API for community programmes and donations.
Developed the SeaFood Logistics & Analytics Dashboard (seafooddashboard.vercel.app) featuring real-time revenue analytics and inventory tracking.
Designed the Kuranet distributed voting API featuring high-availability HAProxy load balancing, MySQL database replication, and DDoS protection.

experience.title: Software Engineering Fellow
achievements: Completed rigorous 12+ month immersive engineering curriculum focused on C systems programming, Linux internals, and distributed web architecture.
Built a custom UNIX command line interpreter in C with process forking, pipelines, environment variable handling, and signal traps.
Re-implemented standard libc printf with variadic argument handling and multiple format specifiers.

experience.title: ICT Officer
experience.company: State Department for Livestock (Government of Kenya)
achievements: Maintained government departmental LAN/WAN infrastructure, structured cabling, switches, and server room equipment.
Managed network device inventory, access control lists (ACLs), and technical support for 200+ users across regional offices.
Performed preventative hardware diagnostics and OS-level security hardening on departmental Linux and Windows servers.
